title: Capstone: A Mini Engine Editor
summary: Combine menus, hierarchy, inspector, console, assets, stats, overlays and theming into one editor, organised around an editor-state struct, panel functions, deferred commands and play mode.

quiz.q: Why does the editor queue Delete/Duplicate/Create instead of running them immediately?
options: ImGui forbids changing data inside Begin/End
Changing the entity array while panels iterate over it shifts indices mid-loop; flushing at the end of the frame is safe
So the console can print them
quiz.explain: Structural changes are deferred to Ed_FlushCommands(). That queue is also the natural foundation for undo/redo.

quiz.q: What does pressing Stop do in the capstone editor?
options: Restores the entity snapshot taken when Play was pressed
quiz.explain: Play snapshots the scene and Stop restores it, so changes made by the running game are discarded, just like in Unity or Unreal.

quiz.q: Why do the editor hotkeys check io.WantTextInput instead of io.WantCaptureKeyboard?
options: With keyboard nav on, any focused panel sets WantCaptureKeyboard, but hotkeys should only be blocked while typing
quiz.explain: Editor hotkeys should work after clicking a panel. Only an active text field should block them.

quiz.q: Why does the editor force ImGuiCond_Always for the first two frames?
options: The menu bar shrinks the viewport work area only from the next frame, so frame-1 positions would end up under the menu
quiz.explain: WorkPos/WorkSize include the menu bar inset one frame late. Forcing the layout briefly fixes the initial placement.
